title: Zero average forces pointwise vanishing
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $f(x)\ge0$ for every $x$. If its uniform expectation $2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}f(x)$ is zero, then $f(x)=0$ for every $x\in\{0,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: The uniform expectation of $f$ is zero
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $f(x)\ge0$ for every $x$.
If its uniform expectation $2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}f(x)$ is zero, then $f(x)=0$
for every $x\in\{0,1\}^n$.
